notes.decision: Punctuation mark closing the section/chapter on the three matters of the faithful. Preserved as-is.

Ornamental chapter-marker preserved in transcription. Function uncertain — likely a decorative paragraph/section divider in the manuscript. May represent a chapter-numbering ornament. Preserved untranslated.

The two ⲡⲓⲣ̄ markers in this MS line frame the chapter title. The second ⲡⲓⲣ̄ falls between [ⲛⲟⲩ] and visible ⲁⲓⲛⲉ — interpreted here as an intra-line ornamental flourish that splits the word ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'of light.' Reading parallel with line 31's ⲗⲁⲟⲩⲉ ⲛ̄ⲱⲛⲍ̄ ⲍⲓ ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ confirms 'anyone of light.'
ϣⲛ̄ = ϣⲓⲛⲉ 'ask, inquire'; ⲡⲛ̄ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ = 'our Illuminator' (1pl possessive). Standard Kephalaia narrative formula introducing disciples' questions to Mani.

'Of strongholds which surround the cosmos' — ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲣⲉ (Lyc. ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲉ 'stronghold/fortress') with ⲉⲧⲕⲱⲧⲉ 'which encircles.' The three cosmic strongholds enclosing the world-system; the disciples' question concerns whether any luminous being emerges from them.

Tentatively translated 'of shining-forth' on the basis of the verbal root ⲡⲓⲉ/ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate' (in glossary, same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance'). The ϩⲡ- prefix may be a Lyc. nominalizing element giving 'place/state of shining.' Confidence moderate; awaits parallel attestation. Alternatively could read 'of the hidden ones' (root ϩⲏⲡ).

Transcription has stray ⲝ and bracket ⲁⲙⲙⲁⲛ̄ⲝ]ⲟⲡⲉ; reading as ⲁ-ⲙ-ⲙⲁⲛϣⲟⲡⲉ 'to the dwelling-places' (ⲙⲁ-ⲛ̄-ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'place of becoming/dwelling,' cf. accumulated ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲡⲉ 'dwelling'). The ⲝ likely represents ϣ in Lyc. orthography.

'The Living Ones' — standard Manichaean term for divine beings in the realm of light (cf. accumulated ⲡⲣⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'the Living Paraclete,' ⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'house of the Living Ones'). The chosen kind is brought up to the Living Ones above.
